<!-- Generated by scripts/api-docs.ts from the TSDoc comments; do not edit. -->

Export Deq shapes to SVG, PDF, AI, EPS, PSD, PNG, JPG, WebP,
AVIF, ICO, a favicon pack, React, Vue, Svelte, CSS, Figma and spec JSON.

Every format goes through `exportShapes`; the per-format functions are exported
too for callers that want one string or byte array.

Source: [`packages/exporters`](../../packages/exporters/). Install with `npm install @0xdolan/deq-exporters`.

## Functions

### `buildDrawing`

```ts
function buildDrawing(p: Prepared, currentColor?: Rgba): Drawing
```

Build the drawing for prepared geometry.

### `canvasPixels`

```ts
function canvasPixels(p: Prepared): { readonly width: number; readonly height: number; }
```

The size in pixels of prepared geometry, as core writes it on the root `<svg>`: `size`
for each 24-unit side, more for the long side of a scene.

### `componentName`

```ts
function componentName(name: string): string
```

PascalCase component name from a kebab-case file name: `roj-half-sun` → `RojHalfSun`.

### `copyToClipboard`

```ts
function copyToClipboard(text: string): Promise<boolean>
```

Copy text (for example `toFigmaSvg` output) to the clipboard in a browser. Figma
pastes SVG markup as editable vectors.

### `cssClass`

```ts
function cssClass(r: Resolved, className?: string | undefined): string
```

A CSS class name for `r`, checked so it cannot break out of the rule.

### `encodeSvg`

```ts
function encodeSvg(svg: string, width: number, format: RasterFormat, options?: EncodeOptions): Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>>
```

Render an SVG and encode it.

### `exportShapes`

```ts
function exportShapes(format: 'svg' | 'svg-layered' | 'svg-sprite' | 'html' | 'jsx' | 'tsx' | 'vue' | 'svelte' | 'data-uri' | 'css-background' | 'css-mask' | 'pdf' | 'ai' | 'eps' | 'png' | 'jpg' | 'webp' | 'avif' | 'ico' | 'favicon' | 'psd' | 'figma' | 'spec-json', items: readonly ExportItem[], options?: ExportOptions): Promise<ExportFile[]>
```

Export items to a format. Returns one or more files; their names are unique and never
contain a path.

**@throws** {DeqError} `INVALID_OPTIONS`, `UNKNOWN_SHAPE`, `INVALID_PARAMETER` or `LIMIT_EXCEEDED`.

### `initRaster`

```ts
function initRaster(wasm?: RasterWasm): Promise<void>
```

Load the resvg WASM renderer once. Node loads the packaged file; browsers must pass
`wasm.resvg` (for example `new URL("@resvg/resvg-wasm/index_bg.wasm", import.meta.url)`)
before the first raster export. Later calls reuse the first result.

### `packIco`

```ts
function packIco(images: readonly { readonly size: number; readonly png: Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>; }[]): Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>
```

Pack PNG images into an ICO container (Windows Vista+ PNG entries).

### `parseColor`

```ts
function parseColor(input: string, current?: Rgba): Rgba
```

Parse a CSS colour. `currentColor` resolves to `current`.

**@throws** {DeqError} `INVALID_OPTIONS` when the colour cannot be converted.

### `rasterize`

```ts
function rasterize(svg: string, width: number): Promise<Bitmap>
```

Render an SVG to straight RGBA pixels.

### `resolveItem`

```ts
function resolveItem(item: ExportItem, defaults?: RenderOptions): Resolved
```

Resolve one item. `defaults` are the exporter's render options; the item's own options
and parameters win.

**@throws** {DeqError} for unknown shapes, bad names, options or parameters.

### `resolveItems`

```ts
function resolveItems(items: readonly ExportItem[], defaults?: RenderOptions): Resolved[]
```

Resolve a list of items, rejecting empty lists, more than `MAX_ITEMS` items and
duplicate file names.

### `splitSvg`

```ts
function splitSvg(svg: string): SvgParts
```

Splits a Deq SVG document into its root attributes and inner markup.

**@throws** Error when the text is not a single `<svg>` element.

### `svgDataUri`

```ts
function svgDataUri(svg: string, base64?: boolean): string
```

A `data:image/svg+xml` URI. Double quotes become single quotes (core escapes `'` in
values), so the result can sit inside `url("...")` or an HTML attribute.

### `toCmyk`

```ts
function toCmyk([r, g, b]: Rgba): [number, number, number, number]
```

Naive device CMYK (no ICC profile): `k = 1 - max(r, g, b)`.

### `toCssBackground`

```ts
function toCssBackground(item: Resolved | ExportItem, className?: string | undefined): string
```

A CSS rule that paints the shape as a background image. Images cannot inherit
`currentColor`, so set `options.color` (default black).

### `toCssMask`

```ts
function toCssMask(item: Resolved | ExportItem, className?: string | undefined): string
```

A CSS rule that uses the shape as a mask over `currentColor`, so it follows the text
colour like an icon font.

### `toDataUri`

```ts
function toDataUri(item: Resolved | ExportItem, base64?: boolean): string
```

A data URI of the optimised SVG.

### `toFaviconPack`

```ts
function toFaviconPack(r: Resolved, options?: FaviconOptions): Promise<ExportFile[]>
```

The favicon pack: `favicon.ico` (16, 32, 48), `favicon.svg` (follows dark mode),
`apple-touch-icon.png` (180), `icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png`, `icon-maskable-512.png`
(80% safe zone) and `site.webmanifest`. All colours are re-serialised as hex.

### `toFigmaSvg`

```ts
function toFigmaSvg(item: Resolved | ExportItem, currentColor?: Rgba): string
```

SVG for pasting into Figma (copy as SVG): every layer is a group whose `id` Figma shows
as the layer name, and `currentColor` is replaced by concrete colours.

### `toHex`

```ts
function toHex([r, g, b, a]: Rgba): string
```

`#rrggbb`, or `#rrggbbaa` when not opaque.

### `toHtml`

```ts
function toHtml(item: Resolved | ExportItem): string
```

An inline SVG snippet ready to paste into HTML.

### `toIco`

```ts
function toIco(r: Resolved, sizes?: readonly number[]): Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>>
```

Render an item at several square sizes into one ICO file.

### `toLayeredSvg`

```ts
function toLayeredSvg(item: Resolved | ExportItem): string
```

Layered SVG: each shape layer is an Inkscape layer (`inkscape:groupmode="layer"`), which
Inkscape, Illustrator and Figma show as named layers.

### `toReact`

```ts
function toReact(r: Resolved, typescript: boolean): string
```

A React component. With `typescript`, a `.tsx` file with a typed props interface.

### `toSpecJson`

```ts
function toSpecJson(r: Resolved): string
```

Pretty-printed spec JSON with a trailing newline.

### `toSpecShape`

```ts
function toSpecShape(r: Resolved): ShapeData
```

The shape behind an exported item. A catalog shape with its default parameters is
returned as is. With custom parameters it becomes a copy (named after the item) whose
parameter defaults are those values, so every layer survives. A composition keeps its
`use` primitives. Render options (colour, size and so on) are not part of a shape.

### `toSprite`

```ts
function toSprite(items: readonly Resolved[], prefix?: string): string
```

An SVG sprite: one `<symbol id="<prefix><name>">` per item, used with
`<svg><use href="sprite.svg#deq-kurdish-sun"/></svg>`.

### `toSvelte`

```ts
function toSvelte(r: Resolved): string
```

A Svelte 5 component (runes, `lang="ts"`).

### `toSvg`

```ts
function toSvg(item: Resolved | ExportItem): string
```

Optimised SVG: core's minimal, deterministic output (`currentColor` by default). For a
scene, the generator's SVG.

### `toVue`

```ts
function toVue(r: Resolved): string
```

A Vue 3 single-file component (`<script setup lang="ts">`).

### `writeEps`

```ts
function writeEps(d: Drawing, options?: EpsOptions): string
```

Write an EPS file for a drawing.

### `writePdf`

```ts
function writePdf(d: Drawing, options?: PdfOptions): Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>
```

Write a one-page PDF for a drawing.

### `writePsd`

```ts
function writePsd(p: Prepared, width: number): Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>>
```

Write a PSD at `width` pixels. Each layer is rendered on its own, so overlaps between
layers blend in Photoshop exactly as in the composite (normal blending).

## Interfaces

### `Bitmap`

```ts
interface Bitmap
```

A rendered bitmap: straight (not premultiplied) RGBA.

- `width: number`
- `height: number`
- `data: Uint8ClampedArray<ArrayBuffer>`

### `CompositionItem`

```ts
interface CompositionItem
```

Several catalog shapes on one canvas, one layer per part (see `compose` in core).

- `parts: readonly CompositionPart[]`
- `options?: RenderOptions`
- `name?: string`: Base file name (kebab case). Default: `composition`.

### `DataItem`

```ts
interface DataItem
```

A shape given as data instead of a catalog id: a custom shape in the spec format, as
core's `renderShapeData` reads it. Its primitives may `use` catalog shapes. The top level
is checked against the full primitive schema first (see `checkShapeData`), and core
enforces its expansion limits while rendering.

- `data: ShapeData`
- `params?: Readonly<Record<string, ParamValue>>`: Shape parameter values; merged over `options.params`.
- `options?: RenderOptions`
- `name?: string`: Base file name (kebab case). Default: the shape's id.

### `DrawOp`

```ts
interface DrawOp
```

One painted path. Colours carry the final alpha (colour alpha × opacity).

- `path: readonly PathCmd[]`
- `fill?: Rgba`
- `stroke?: Rgba`

### `Drawing`

```ts
interface Drawing
```

- `width: number`: Page width and height in points (1 px = 0.75 pt).
- `height: number`
- `base: Matrix`: Canvas units to page points, with the y axis flipped.
- `transforms: readonly Matrix[]`: The rotation/flip transforms, outermost first (as in core's SVG).
- `lineWidth: number`
- `linecap: 0 | 1 | 2`
- `linejoin: 0 | 1 | 2`
- `background?: DrawOp`
- `layers: readonly { readonly id: string; readonly ops: readonly DrawOp[]; }[]`: Layers in first-use (bottom to top) order.
- `title: string`

### `EncodeOptions`

```ts
interface EncodeOptions
```

- `quality?: number`: Quality 0 to 100 for JPG, WebP and AVIF. Default 90 (JPG, WebP) and 70 (AVIF).
- `matte?: Rgba`: JPG has no transparency: transparent pixels are composited onto this colour.

### `EpsOptions`

```ts
interface EpsOptions
```

- `colorSpace?: ColorSpace`

### `ExportFile`

```ts
interface ExportFile
```

One output file. Text formats return a string, binary formats a `Uint8Array`.

- `name: string`: File name with extension, for example `kurdish-sun.pdf`. Never contains a path.
- `mediaType: string`: IANA media type.
- `data: string | Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>`

### `ExportOptions`

```ts
interface ExportOptions
```

Options for `exportShapes`. Options a format does not use are ignored.

- `render?: RenderOptions`: Render options for every item (an item's own `options` win).
- `currentColor?: string`: What `currentColor` means where nothing inherits it (PDF, AI, EPS, raster, PSD, Figma). Default black.
- `scales?: readonly number[]`: Raster and PSD scale factors: 1 gives `size` px, 2 gives `name@2x.png`. Default `[1]`.
- `quality?: number`: JPG, WebP and AVIF quality, 0 to 100.
- `matte?: string`: JPG background for transparent pixels. Default white.
- `colorSpace?: ColorSpace`: PDF, AI and EPS colour space. Default `rgb`.
- `layers?: boolean`: PDF and AI: one Optional Content Group per layer. Default true.
- `prefix?: string`: Sprite symbol id prefix. Default `deq-`.
- `base64?: boolean`: Data URIs: base64 instead of percent encoding. Default false.
- `icoSizes?: readonly number[]`: ICO sizes. Default 16, 32 and 48.
- `favicon?: FaviconOptions`: Favicon pack options (one item only).

### `FaviconOptions`

```ts
interface FaviconOptions
```

- `name?: string`: App name in `site.webmanifest`. Default: the shape's English name.
- `shortName?: string`: Short app name. Default: `name`.
- `color?: string`: Icon colour in light mode and in the PNG icons. Default: the render colour, or black.
- `darkColor?: string`: Icon colour when the browser is in dark mode (`favicon.svg` only). Default white.
- `background?: string`: Opaque background of the Apple touch and maskable icons. Default white.
- `themeColor?: string`: `theme_color` in the manifest. Default: `background`.

### `LeetItem`

```ts
interface LeetItem
```

Deq Leet text as one wide scene with one layer per character (see `leet` in
`@0xdolan/deq-generator`). The exporter's render options apply except the per-shape
ones (`rotation`, `flipX`, `flipY`, `params`, `layerColors`).

- `leet: string`
- `options?: LeetOptions`
- `name?: string`: Base file name (kebab case). Default: `deq-leet`.

### `PatternItem`

```ts
interface PatternItem
```

A seeded pattern of motifs as one scene with one layer per motif (see `pattern`).

- `pattern: PatternOptions`
- `name?: string`: Base file name (kebab case). Default: `deq-<kind>` (`deq-band` without a kind).

### `PdfOptions`

```ts
interface PdfOptions
```

- `colorSpace?: ColorSpace`: Device colour space. CMYK uses a naive conversion without an ICC profile.
- `layers?: boolean`: Put each shape layer in its own Optional Content Group. Default true.
- `creator?: string`: `/Creator` in the document info.

### `RasterWasm`

```ts
interface RasterWasm
```

WASM sources for browsers and bundlers. Node finds the packaged files by itself.

- `resvg?: unknown`: The `@resvg/resvg-wasm/index_bg.wasm` file as a URL, a `Response`, its bytes or a compiled `WebAssembly.Module` (or a promise of one of these).

### `Resolved`

```ts
interface Resolved
```

An item resolved into a shape description, its render options and its geometry.

- `name: string`: Safe base file name.
- `shape: ShapeData`
- `options: RenderOptions`: The merged render options (unresolved, so a format can override some of them).
- `prepared: Prepared`
- `scene?: string`: For scenes (Leet and patterns): the generator's own SVG, which SVG-based formats return unchanged so the output stays decodable. `prepared` has the same geometry, one layer per cell, for the other formats.

### `SceneItem`

```ts
interface SceneItem
```

A scene built by the caller from generator output, for example Leet text framed by a
pattern in the website. Cells place glyphs of catalog shapes; the scene is checked
against a strict schema and core's expansion limits.

- `scene: Scene`
- `options?: SceneOptions`
- `title?: string`: The default title. Default: empty (the SVG is decorative unless options set one).
- `name?: string`: Base file name (kebab case). Default: `deq-scene`.

### `ShapeItem`

```ts
interface ShapeItem
```

One catalog shape, with optional parameters and render options.

- `shape: string`: Catalog shape id, for example `roj-half-sun`.
- `params?: Readonly<Record<string, ParamValue>>`: Shape parameter values; merged over `options.params`.
- `options?: RenderOptions`: Render options for this item; merged over the exporter's `render` options.
- `name?: string`: Base file name (kebab case). Default: the shape id.

### `SvgParts`

```ts
interface SvgParts
```

A Deq SVG document split by `splitSvg`.

- `attrs: readonly (readonly [string, string])[]`
- `inner: string`

## Types

### `ColorSpace`

```ts
type ColorSpace = "rgb" | "cmyk"
```

PDF/EPS colour model for paints.

### `ExportFormat`

```ts
type ExportFormat = (typeof FORMATS)[number]
```

One of the 23 export format ids in `FORMATS`.

### `ExportItem`

```ts
type ExportItem = string | ShapeItem | CompositionItem | DataItem | LeetItem | PatternItem | SceneItem
```

What every exporter accepts: a shape id, a `ShapeItem`, a `CompositionItem`,
a `DataItem`, a `LeetItem`, a `PatternItem` or a `SceneItem`.

### `Matrix`

```ts
type Matrix = readonly [number, number, number, number, number, number]
```

An affine matrix `[a, b, c, d, e, f]` (PDF `cm` and SVG `matrix()` order).

### `PathCmd`

```ts
type PathCmd = | readonly ["m", number, number] | readonly ["l", number, number] | readonly ["c", number, number, number, number, number, number] | readonly ["h"]
```

A path command in canvas units.

### `RasterFormat`

```ts
type RasterFormat = "png" | "jpg" | "webp" | "avif"
```

Raster encodings.

### `Rgba`

```ts
type Rgba = readonly [number, number, number, number]
```

Red, green, blue and alpha, each 0 to 1 (sRGB, not premultiplied).
